SnapOtter is an open-source, self-hosted file-processing suite with 200+ tools for converting, compressing, OCR, transcription, metadata removal, image editing, and local AI.

Everything runs on your own hardware, keeping your files on your network.

It also supports REST APIs, pipelines, OIDC/SSO, and AMD64/ARM64.

More details: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/tool.html?id=snapotter
